title: State relabelling commutes with runs
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$ with state set $S$, let $e:S\simeq S'$ be a bijection of state sets, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on an input word $x$. For every finite Boolean choice word $w$, running the machine obtained by relabelling states by $e$ from the configuration with its state relabelled by $e$ gives the same configuration as running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ and then relabelling the resulting state by $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A machine with $k$ work tapes, alphabet $\Gamma$, and state set $S$.
